about_the_game:
MASH VP! Re:VISION Paid DLC Vol. 3!

Cross-border musical dialogue through collaboration and remix tracks by top artists from Japan and Korea!

Featuring the first-ever collaboration track by NAOKI and EmoCosine:

Future Logic feat. Jang Mi (VA Vocal) / NAOKI + EmoCosine

Remixes by top artists from both countries include:

Cutter -Tatsh Scissors Mix- / EmoCosine

Xemetis -RiraN REMIX- / Tatsh

Also included is a K-pop flavored original track from AXTORM SOUND RELATION, featuring Korean vocals:

CRYSTAL LOVE -Bridging to Emotion ver- / ASR feat. neur6sia

Showcasing the clear and captivating vocals of neur6sia.

And for the first time in MASH VP! Re:VISION, a Triple Mashup by a single artist makes its debut:

Cutter x DistLuv x Love Pills

A long-awaited mashup that spans the emotional world of EmoCosine!

The following tracks will be added to FREE PLAY mode:

  • CRYSTAL LOVE -Bridging to Emotion ver- / ASR feat. neur6sia

  • Future Logic feat. Jang Mi (VA Vocal) / NAOKI + EmoCosine

  • Love Pills / EmoCosine

  • NostalgiA / HyuN & MIIM

  • Cutter -Tatsh Scissors Mix- / EmoCosine

  • Xemetis -RiraN REMIX- / Tatsh

Ported from the arcade rhythm game “CHRONO CIRCLE”:

  • Starry Story (feat. Narae) / HyuN & MIIM

  • Cotton Candy / Abel & RiraN

  • Game Changer / Cosmograph

Additional mashup tracks will also be added to MASH UP mode:

  • Cutter -Tatsh Scissors Mix- x Love Pills

  • NostalgiA x Cutter -Tatsh Scissors Mix-

  • Love Pills x NostalgiA

Also including the Triple Mashup:

  • Cutter x DistLuv x Love Pills

Two new in-game backgrounds will be also included!
